title: 第15章 亚少赛(下)第16章 武汉帮
content_zh:
第十五章 亚少赛（下）
余海向中路内切之后，进攻的选择一下子多了起来，而韩国队的球员一时间却根本不知道该怎么防了，原本严密的防线顿时变得漏洞百出。而完全发挥出自己变速和变向能力的余海则连续在中路获得了两次起脚打门的机会，可惜从左路内切后他射门得用自己不擅长的右脚（其实余海左脚射门同样很烂，即使是没有大伤之前，当时他牛逼的主要是突破和传中，17岁刚出道时就成为了中超的半程助攻王。），精度实在是令人不敢恭维，两脚机会不错的射门全都打偏，令场下的刘春铭教练捶胸顿足......
但正所谓“事不过三”，余海的第三脚射门终于打在了门框范围以内，虽然遗憾地被表现神勇的韩国队门将奋力扑出，但皮球并没有飞远，不知什么时候跑到了禁区边缘的右后卫张程林凌空抽射打出了一记精彩绝伦的世界波，已经倒在地上的韩国队门将对此全无办法，只能目送皮球入网，双方又重新回到了同一条起跑线上......
比分被扳平之后，韩国队立即反守为攻，但正如高军所熟知的那样，韩国队阵地进攻的战术相当简单，只要扎紧篱笆、不走神，他们很难获得好的机会，相反中国队却利用反击的机会多次威胁到韩国队的球门。
下半场第11分钟，一直被韩国后卫严密盯防的高军终于获得了本场第一次起脚射门的机会，但是由于本场对方门将表现神勇造成的心理压力，高军过于追求角度而打在了门柱上弹出，好在跟他早已形成默契的余海及时前插，轻松地将皮球补射进网。
15分钟后，毛建卿在即将被换下场之前抽出一记高质量的射门，却打在横梁下缘弹出，及时前插的高军鱼跃冲顶，打进了他本场比赛的唯一进球，同时也是这场比赛的最后一个进球，中国U17少年队以3：1击败夙敌韩国队，夺取了这届亚少赛的冠军！
亚少赛最后两场的出色表现令高军获得了不少业内专家的赞誉，但由于当初徐根保“吹得太过”，那些逆反心理较强的人却反而不断鼓噪说高军是“昙花一现”、“运气好而已”诸如此类，而各家媒体更是抓住这个机会，又大肆炒作了一番，至于人家小孩会不会因此废掉，他们才不会管呢！
不过现在高军现在可没有闲工夫理他们，将蒿骏敏拉进基地之后，受此启发想起另外几个国内小牛的高军向徐指导提出了一个要求......
“什么？球探？”，徐指导虽然是目前国内最好的本土教练，但对于球探工作，却还是习惯于由教练顺便完成的老模式，并没有在基地乃至未来的俱乐部中设立专职球探的想法，因此听到高军主动提出要兼职球探之后，不免很是诧异，不过徐指导考虑了一会儿之后最终还是同意了高军的请求......
这一方面是考虑到那些顶级的天才球员往往眼光独到，而之前高军帮谢文俊、蔡惠康等人改位置后令其表现很快就判若两人的先例，已经足以证明他这方面的能力，而他最近挖来的蒿骏敏没花基地一分钱，却足以成为未来建队后的核心球员，就更是说明了高军的眼光。
而更多的，则是徐根保考虑到高军来到基地后实在太过努力，每天除了训练就是自学各种知识，从来不见他像寻常的孩子一样嬉笑玩乐。徐根保虽然素以严厉著称，但也知道一个孩子如果自小就失去应有的童真，对他的成长其实并不是一件好事，因此让他有个机会离开基地出去逛逛也好，而如果真能再找到一些好苗子，那就更好了......
徐根保虽然是那个时代过来的，有些思想不可避免地比较保守，但对于高军直接跑到其他足球学校乃至俱乐部梯队挖人的想法，徐指导也没有表示反对，毕竟即使是欧洲那些有名的青训球队，也一样经常从其他俱乐部的梯队挖好苗子的，其实历史上徐根保从江苏把武球王搞到手就是这么干的......
必须说明的是，之所以现在高军急着帮基地挖人，还有一个直接的原因，那就是徐根保已经决定推翻原定的计划、提前组队参加乙级联赛。原本在徐根保的计划里，组队参加乙级联赛要到2005年甚至2006年，但是有了高军这个妖孽之后，为了不耽误这个国内从未有过的奇才，徐根保决定在来年、即2003年便提前组队参加中乙。
为此徐根保对基地的各级梯队进行了一定的精简，原来的87年龄组与88年龄组合并成一队、总人数压缩到25人，原来的89年龄组则与90年龄组合并成一队，同样压缩到25人，而后来招的91年龄组与92年龄组则依旧单独组队，人数也多得多，还是采取老的模式。
这自然让那些被淘汰出局的孩子十分痛苦，不过从他们的未来前途考虑，却未必就是一件坏事。在中国足球的现有体制下，踢球不可避免地会影响学业，尤其是到了高中以后，如果明明没有足球天赋却硬要留下，到时候成不了职业球员养不了家，却又耽误了上学，损失可就太大了......
虽然徐指导已经提前开始准备，但崇明基地组队参加来年的乙级联赛还是很可能会遇到不小的困难，因为即使是87年出生的球员到2003年时也才十五六岁，而且因为崇明基地的小球员基本都是真实年龄，因此实际差距更大。而足球毕竟是一项对抗激烈的运动，身体素质十分重要，一队十五六岁的少年就算技术意识再好，也很难与身高体壮的成年球员抗衡，何况目前队中除了高军这个妖孽，别的小球员在技术上并没有那么大的优势，最好的几个也不过才有甲A弱队主力的水准（仅仅指技术），这还没考虑实战经验的巨大差距。

Chapter 15 Asian Junior Championship (Part 2)
After Yu Hai cut inside to the center, there were suddenly more offensive options. However, the players of the Korean team did not know how to defend at all. The originally tight defense line suddenly became full of holes. Yu Hai, who fully demonstrated his ability to change speed and direction, got two consecutive chances to hit the goal in the middle. Unfortunately, after cutting in from the left, he had to shoot with his right foot, which he was not good at (in fact, Yu Hai's left foot shot was also bad, even before he was seriously injured. At that time, he was mainly good at breakthroughs and crosses. When he debuted at the age of 17, he became the half-time assist leader in the Chinese Super League.), his accuracy was really unflattering. Both of his good shots missed, which made coach Liu Chunming beat his chest...
But as the saying goes, "Things can only be done in three seconds." Yu Hai's third shot finally hit the goal frame. Although it was unfortunately saved by the brave South Korean goalkeeper, the ball did not fly far. The right back Zhang Chenglin who ran to the edge of the penalty area at some time volleyed a wonderful world wave. The South Korean goalkeeper, who had fallen to the ground, had no choice but to watch the ball go into the net. The two sides returned to the same starting line...
After the score was equalized, the Korean team immediately counterattacked, but as Gao Jun is well aware, the Korean team's offensive tactics are quite simple. As long as they tighten the fence and don't lose focus, it is difficult for them to get good opportunities. On the contrary, the Chinese team has used counterattack opportunities to threaten the Korean team's goal many times.
In the 11th minute of the second half, Gao Jun, who had been closely monitored by South Korean defenders, finally got his first chance to shoot. However, due to the psychological pressure caused by the opponent's goalkeeper's heroic performance, Gao Jun pursued the angle too much and hit the goalpost. Fortunately, Yu Hai, who had already formed a tacit understanding with him, stepped forward in time and easily shot the ball into the net.
15 minutes later, Mao Jianqing took a high-quality shot before he was about to be substituted, but it hit the lower edge of the crossbar and bounced out. Gao Jun, who advanced in time, dived and scored his only goal of the game. It was also the last goal of the game. The Chinese U17 youth team defeated the old enemy South Korea 3:1 and won the championship of this Asian Youth Championship!
Gao Jun's outstanding performance in the last two games of the Asian Youth Championship earned Gao Jun praise from many experts in the industry. However, because Xu Genbao "exaggerated" at the beginning, those with a strong rebellious mentality continued to clamor that Gao Jun was "a flash in the pan" and "just lucky". Various media seized this opportunity and hyped it up. As for whether his children will be ruined because of this, they don't care!
But now Gao Jun has no time to deal with them. After pulling Hao Junmin into the base, Gao Jun was inspired to think of several other domestic Mavericks and made a request to Director Xu...
"What? Scout?" Although Director Xu is currently the best local coach in the country, he is still used to the old model of scouting work being done incidentally by coaches. He has no idea of setting up full-time scouts in the base or even future clubs. Therefore, he was surprised when he heard Gao Jun offer to be a part-time scout. However, Director Xu finally agreed to Gao Jun's request after thinking about it for a while...
On the one hand, this is due to the fact that top talented players often have unique vision, and the precedent that Gao Jun helped Xie Wenjun, Cai Huikang and others change their positions so that their performance quickly became completely different is enough to prove his ability in this area. And the Hao Junmin he recently poached did not cost the base a penny, but he is enough to become a core player after the team is built in the future, which further illustrates Gao Jun's vision.
What's more, Xu Genbao considered that Gao Jun worked too hard after coming to the base. In addition to training every day, he taught himself various knowledge. He never looked like him.Laughing and having fun like ordinary children. Although Xu Genbao is known for being strict, he also knows that if a child loses his innocence since he was a child, it is actually not a good thing for his growth, so it would be good to give him a chance to leave the base and go out for a walk, and it would be even better if he could really find some good seedlings...
Although Xu Genbao came from that era, some of his thoughts are inevitably conservative, but Director Xu did not object to Gao Jun's idea of going directly to other football schools or even the club echelon to recruit people. After all, even the famous youth training teams in Europe often recruit good talents from the echelon of other clubs. In fact, this is how Xu Genbao obtained the martial arts king from Jiangsu in history...
It must be noted that there is another direct reason why Gao Jun is now eager to recruit people for the base, and that is that Xu Genbao has decided to overturn the original plan and form a team in advance to participate in the second division league. Originally, Xu Genbao's plan was to form a team to participate in the Second Division League in 2005 or even 2006. However, with the monster Gao Jun, Xu Genbao decided to form a team to participate in the Second Division League in advance in the next year, that is, in 2003, in order not to delay this talent that had never been seen in the country.
For this reason, Xu Genbao streamlined the echelons at all levels of the base to a certain extent. The original 87-year-old group and the 88-year-old group were combined into one team, and the total number of people was reduced to 25. The original 89-year-old group was combined with the 90-year-old group, and the number was also reduced to 25 people. The 91-year-old group and the 92-year-old group recruited later still formed separate teams with much larger numbers, and still adopted the old model.
This naturally makes those children who are eliminated very painful, but considering their future prospects, it is not necessarily a bad thing. Under the current system of Chinese football, playing football will inevitably affect academic studies, especially after high school. If you insist on staying despite clearly not having the talent for football, then you will not be able to become a professional player and support your family, but you will also delay going to school. The loss will be too great...
Although Director Xu has already started preparations in advance, the Chongming base team is still likely to encounter considerable difficulties in forming a team to participate in the second division league next year, because even the players born in 1987 were only fifteen or sixteen years old in 2003, and because the young players in the Chongming base are basically of their true age, the actual gap is even greater. After all, football is a highly competitive sport, and physical fitness is very important. No matter how good the technical awareness of a team of fifteen or sixteen-year-old boys is, it will be difficult for them to compete with tall and strong adult players. Moreover, except for the monster Gao Jun, the other young players in the team do not have such a big technical advantage. The best ones are only as good as the main players of a weak team in Class A (only in terms of skills), and this does not take into account the huge gap in actual combat experience.
